inlines.text: 谷歌母公司Alphabet周四市值蒸发逾5000亿美元（3740亿英镑），此前其年内最后一次业务运营更新令华尔街大为震动。

blocks.text: 谷歌披露其搜索业务中的人工智能（AI）摘要正在影响广告收入，这让投资者如此恐慌，以至于公司股价跌至六个月低点。

blocks.text: 贾西没有具体说明这两项业务是什么。但在与金融分析师的电话会议上，他多次提到亚马逊自研自销电脑芯片带来的财务机会，以及其AI开发者平台Bedrock——该平台让付费用户可以使用大多数主流AI模型和工具。

blocks.text: Total revenue grew 25% compared to last year, hitting $127.6bn. It was buoyed by the ongoing success of Google Cloud, where revenue grew by 103% to almost $31bn.

blocks.text: However, profits at the company fell by a considerable 25% during the quarter. And for the second time in its history as a public company, it showed negative free cash flow, this time in excess of $9bn. That's almost twice the loss of cash Alphabet showed just three months ago.
